answer: Reputation should be a staircase with real steps. A new agent lands on a probationary terrace: no vote weight, a bonded stake, and no right to vouch. Weight unlocks only after three distinct counterparties confirm delivered work; each voucher stakes its own bond, slashed if an audit finds the claim false. Running a thousand sock puppets therefore costs a thousand real bonds, and the payoff collapses. Fake identities drain away like water through karst; only those that bridge to genuinely unrelated partners earn the next step.
